purpose: Prove the governance loop with the curated Skills lane before expanding to more terminal consumers.
known_baselines: the private user-configuration to agent-skills-curated base logic chain has already been verified
the MVP verifies iterative governance over the working chain, not basic connectivity from zero

workstreams.title: Source candidate selection
workstreams.goal: Select a small, high-value Skill candidate set from reviewed discovery inputs.
acceptance: candidate source is pinned
candidate reason is recorded
license/provenance state is recorded
candidate remains non-executable before approval

workstreams.title: Review, neutralize, and adapt
workstreams.goal: Turn selected candidates into public-safe, agent-neutral, portable Skill material.
acceptance: security review evidence exists
private or vendor-specific assumptions are removed or bounded
overlap and conflict review is recorded
adaptation keeps source attribution and license boundaries
workstreams.human_gate: approve non-runtime adapted draft creation; MVP-03 release-or-routing review requires separate approval

workstreams.title: Deterministic release manifest
workstreams.goal: Publish only approved Skill payloads through deterministic manifest evidence.
acceptance: manifest schema remains declared
manifest includes only approved payload files
hash and size verification pass
extra, missing, symlink, traversal, and boundary violations fail closed
workstreams.human_gate: approve release candidate before consumer install

workstreams.title: Private consumer install and verification
workstreams.goal: Have a private configuration repository consume the curated release safely.
acceptance: consumer pin is explicit
install plan is reviewable
backup or rollback path exists
installed files match manifest
private runtime state is not published
workstreams.human_gate: authorize install or restore in the private runtime context

workstreams.title: Routing and runtime use
workstreams.goal: Verify that curated Skills can be selected through capability routing without becoming mandatory for every task.
acceptance: capability-router remains capability decision router
simple tasks can use native or no-skill path
approved Skill triggers work in representative scenarios
candidate or unapproved Skills do not enter execution path
fallback behavior is documented
workstreams.human_gate: confirm high-risk, ambiguous, or side-effecting routes

workstreams.title: Feedback, lifecycle, and retirement
workstreams.goal: Feed runtime evidence back into governance without mutating private projects directly.
acceptance: runtime result is summarized as public-safe evidence or kept private
accepted, rejected, deprecated, or retired state is recorded
resource radar can consume safe decision metadata for dedupe
lessons update shared governance only when generalizable
workstreams.human_gate: approve promotion of lessons into public governance

workstreams.title: Global closeout and public refresh
workstreams.goal: Verify the MVP across the repository family and update public docs, topology, indexes, and promotion material only where evidence supports it.
acceptance: per-repository verification status is recorded
topology, repository map, shared baseline, and indexes are reviewed
README and public docs distinguish planned, proven, and deferred claims
promotion and video material remain postponed until evidence-backed refresh
process artifacts are classified as promoted evidence, archived context, deleted residue, or explicitly ignored non-authority
temporary scaffolds, stale drafts, raw experiments, and obsolete reports do not become a second truth source
retained artifacts have an ongoing quality, health, security, and compliance posture instead of a one-time pass/fail label
code, schemas, reports, docs, images, automation, and governance records are treated as lifecycle artifacts that can decay and require re-checking
durable state, continuity anchors, and recovery paths are recorded so the system can resume across time, environments, agents, and interrupted threads
important automation, routing, scoring, promotion, rejection, cleanup, and release decisions are observable and explainable through public-safe evidence
next-step decision is recorded: iterate Skills, pause, or incubate another terminal consumer
workstreams.human_gate: approve public closeout claims and any promotion refresh

closeout_gates.description: The chain is proven from candidate selection to private runtime consumption.
Public/private, candidate/approved, and automation/human-gate boundaries are preserved.
The Skill lane improves real work without over-triggering or replacing native capability unnecessarily.
Operational evidence can update discovery, governance, or lifecycle state without direct private-project mutation.
The team can decide whether another terminal consumer is worth incubating.
The MVP is verified across the hub, curated Skills lane, private consumer, discovery feedback, and affected templates or projections.
README, docs, topology, indexes, and promotion material are updated only for evidence-backed claims; video remains optional and post-closeout.
Temporary and process artifacts are promoted, archived, deleted, or marked non-authoritative instead of becoming repository sediment.
Retained artifacts have ongoing quality, health, security, and compliance posture instead of one-time validation theater.
Durable state, continuity anchors, and recovery paths can resume work across time, environments, agents, and interruptions.
Important automation, routing, scoring, promotion, rejection, cleanup, and release decisions are inspectable and explainable through public-safe evidence.
